COP31 Climate Summit Opens Amidst Finance Disputes and Unresolved Issues

The 31st UN climate conference, COP31, has opened in Antalya, Turkey, with delegates carrying forward unresolved decisions from the previous summit. The talks are scheduled to run until November 20. A primary dispute has emerged over climate finance, with rich and developing nations clashing on the issue. The UN chief has warned that the climate crisis is 'outrunning us'. While the summit emphasizes electrification, a plan to fully ditch fossil fuels is still needed. Separately, the British Prime Minister is set to attend, potentially prioritizing the cost of living over climate targets by reducing electric vehicle goals.
